title: Rook Opens, Queen Ends
setup: Black's king is walled in by its own pawns on g7 and h7, and your rook has a wide-open b-file.
hint: Chase the king to the one square its pawns still allow, then find the mate your rook can protect.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rb8+}} seizes the back rank. The pawns on g7 and h7 block their own king, so {{Kf7}} is the only legal move. Then {{Qe8#}}: the queen lands beside the king, guarded by the rook on b8, with every escape square covered.
